description: Read a Bible passage in one or more editions side by side (Hebrew WLC, Greek Septuagint, SBL Greek NT, English WEB/King James/ASV/Douay-Rheims/Brenton, Russian Synodal, Luther 1912, Louis Segond), each verse with its permanent link and a ready citation. Editions can be ids, short names or plain words ("kjv", "WEB", "Hebrew", "Greek"). Reference numbering is WEB, or WEB Classic for additional books it holds, otherwise Brenton. source_numbering identifies native verses. Unestablished correspondences are flagged aligned:false with no counterpart text.

editions.description: Editions, e.g. ["hebrew","lxx","kjv"] (ids from list_editions; a comma list works too). Defaults to the reference edition: en, web-full or lxx-en for that book.
